function: DQN outputs the HAP transmit beamforming vectors maximizing the minimum harvested energy under secrecy capacity and power constraints, for consolidated and split signal cases (p. 6, 8-9).
system: Hybrid access point with N_T=10 antennas, L=3 single-antenna EH nodes, one single-antenna ID receiver, K=4 two-antenna eavesdroppers; Rician fading; no RIS; band not stated (p. 4, 12).
method: DQN: Q-learning with a fully connected DNN (hidden layers of 120 and 60 nodes), reinforcement training with Adam on simulated CSI; one agent (p. 11-12).
data_channel: Custom simulated channel: path-loss exponent 3, Rician fading (K-factor 3 dB), norm-bounded CSI errors, generated randomly per episode; no standard model or measurement (p. 4, 7, 14).
test_conditions: Random channel draws per training episode; sweeps of maximum transmit power, EH nodes L and eavesdroppers K; model tailored to specific node-antenna configurations (p. 14, 20).
baselines: SCA [23] and SDP [24] optimization (non-learned); DNN without Q-learning, DDQN [26] and D3QN (learned) (p. 12-14).
metrics: Harvested energy, secrecy capacity, power efficiency, energy efficiency, cumulative reward, convergence versus iterations (p. 13-19).
complexity: Big-O complexity O(sum of N_{l-1}N_l over layers) for the DQN compared with SCA and SDP bounds in Table III (p. 19-20).
q1_support: p. 4: "The Rician factor is assumed to be KR = 3 dB"; custom path-loss plus Rician simulator, with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 20: "The current DL model is tailored for specific node-antenna configurations"; the sweeps over L and K (p. 14) do not state a model trained at one configuration and tested at another.
q3_support: p. 12: "compare the results of DQN, DNN (without the inclusion of Q-learning), SCA [23], SDP [24], and DDQN algorithms [26]"; harvested energy and secrecy capacity are compared (p. 13).
q4_support: p. 19: "the proposed DQN with the approximate complexity bound" O of the sum of N(l-1)N(l); Table III (p. 20) lists the SCA and SDP complexity bounds.
q5_support: p. 12: "we generated a set of channel state information"; the channel data are simulated, and the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Area 3: the DQN action is the HAP transmit beamforming vector (p. 9), a multi-antenna precoder; the secrecy and energy harvesting objectives do not change the function. Tables II and III (p. 12, 20) read from page images.
